description: Cloud infrastructure, site reliability, CI/CD automation, and platform engineering roles.
expectedArtifacts: Kubernetes Helm charts and manifest configurations
CI/CD workflow definitions (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
Grafana dashboards, Prometheus alert rules, Datadog monitors
Post-mortem incident reports and disaster recovery drills
commonMetricPlaceholders: maintained [99.99]% uptime SLA across [N] production microservices
reduced deployment build times by [X]% from [A] mins to [B] mins
cut annual cloud expenditure by $[Y]k through spot instances and rightsizing
reduced MTTR from [Z] hours to [W] minutes via automated canary rollbacks
rejectionPitfalls: Listing cloud buzzwords without specifying concrete infrastructure automation or architectures
Lack of metrics reflecting availability, MTTR, build speed, or cloud spend optimization
No evidence of operational incident response or post-incident root cause prevention
hiringSignals: Multi-region high availability architectures and automated disaster recovery execution
Authoring internal developer platform tooling that accelerates engineering team velocity
Production experience managing complex database migrations with zero downtime
